title.en: Practical 5: Identification of adaptations in animals

text.en: Fish, frog, calotes, dove and rat live in very different places with bodies to match.

The aim is to identify adaptations in animals. The animals given are fish, frog, calotes, dove and rat.
For each animal, observe its habitat, body structure, body covering and locomotory organs, and note them in the table.
For example, a fish lives in water and has fins and gills; a dove flies with wings and has feathers; a rat is a land mammal with fur. Write one or two adaptations that help each animal survive in its habitat.
